result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but there is a horizontal overflow issue in the 'Fastest near you' carousel: the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the screen edge, which is expected for a carousel, but its truncated name with an ellipsis mid-word at the card boundary looks broken. Also minor contrast and spacing concerns.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is clipped at the right edge of the screen with its title truncated mid-word, creating a visually broken appearance rather than a clean peek of the next card
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel so the next card peeks cleanly (e.g., ~80% visible with a defined peek width), or apply proper text truncation with ellipsis that doesn't cut off at the container edge

issues.description: Delivery fee text ('€0.90 delivery') under card titles is small and low-contrast gray, which may be hard to read
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast or slightly increase font size for delivery fee labels

issues.description: The category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are cut off at the right edge, suggesting the last chip may be partially hidden
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontally scrollable chip row shows a partial hint of the next chip consistently, or add a visual scroll affordance
